title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES INTENSIFYING THE CAMPAIGN AND EXTENDING UP TO JUNE 19, 1951, THE PERIOD FIXED IN DECEMBER 16, 1948, FOR THE COLLECTION OF FUNDS WITH WHICH TO FINANCE THE RE- PAIR OR RECONSTRUCTION OF THE HOUSE OF DR. JOSE RIZAL IN CALAMBA, LAGUNA, AND OF DAPITAN PARK IN ZAMBOANGA.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
particularly the school children, and a place which tourists
from abroad should visit;
WHEREAS, for the P132,400.26 already contributed by
public and private school children, the sum of P106.694.20
has already been spent for the reconstruction of Dr. Rizal's
Calamba home and P10,000 more will be used to furnish it;
WHEREAS, an additional amount of approximately
P118,000 will be needed to reconstruct the Dapitan Park
in Zamboanga, so that a grand total of P250,000 is needed
for the reconstruction of both the Calamia Home and
Dapitan Park;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby call upon all citizens and residents of the Phil
ippines, irrespective of nationality or creed, to assist in
this patriotic endeavor. I authorize not only the officials
and teachers of all public and private schools, colleges,
and universities, but also all other officials of the Govern-
ment and semi-government agencies, civic organizations,
and the general public to intensify and extend the campaign
for voluntary contributions, not only from publie and
private educational institutions, but also from the other
agencies of the country, both Government and private, in
order to raise the total amount of P250,000 by June 19,
1951, for the furnishing of the reconstituted house of
Dr. Jose Rizal in Calamba, Laguna, and for the restoration
of the Dapitan Park in Zamboanga. I authorize the Secre-
tary of Education, who is the Chairman of the committee
in charge of the restoration of these historical sites, the
Director of Public Schools and Director of Private Schools,
who are members of this committee, to accept voluntary
contributions for this fund and to issue official receipts
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
